name: Tax & Audit Evidence Readiness Hub
description: Human-led evidence readiness for tax and audit preparation: cases, checklists, evidence, tasks, pack indexes and approvals. Never makes tax decisions or files returns.

tools.name: create_case
tools.description: Create a human-owned tax/audit preparation case. This does not create a tax opinion or filing.

case_name.description: Human-readable case name, e.g. 'FY2025 audit PBC — Acme'
case_name.title: Case Name

period.description: Human-defined reporting or audit period, e.g. 'FY2025' or '2026-01'
period.title: Period

request_type.description: Purpose, e.g. audit PBC, tax inquiry, month-end close
request_type.title: Request Type

owner.description: Person accountable for coordinating the preparation
owner.title: Owner

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.description: Add a human-authored document/control requirement to a case.

description.description: Why the item is needed or how it must be checked
description.title: Description

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.description: Update a checklist status. Only a named human may mark it approved_for_pack.

review_note.description: Human review note; required for rejection
review_note.title: Review Note

tools.name: register_evidence
tools.description: Register an existing HTTPS evidence source. This app does not fetch, interpret or validate the document.

source_url.description: HTTPS link to a document or its approved storage location
source_url.title: Source Url

checklist_item_id.description: Optional checklist item this evidence supports
checklist_item_id.title: Checklist Item Id

period.description: Period asserted by the submitting user; requires human review
period.title: Period

reference.description: Reference, invoice number, registry number, etc.; requires human review
reference.title: Reference

owner.description: Person who supplied or owns the evidence
owner.title: Owner

tools.name: review_evidence
tools.description: Record a human evidence review. Only a named human may mark evidence approved_for_pack.

review_note.description: Human review note; required for rejection
review_note.title: Review Note

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a human-owned preparation task for a case.

evidence_item_id.description: Optional evidence item this task relates to
evidence_item_id.title: Evidence Item Id

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a human-owned preparation task status.

tools.name: list_checklist_items
tools.description: List case checklist items and their review status.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List registered evidence sources and human review status for one case.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List human-owned preparation tasks for one case.

tools.name: build_evidence_pack
tools.description: Build a read-only index of evidence already approved by a named human. It is not a tax opinion or filing.

tools.name: approve_evidence_pack
tools.description: A named human approves the latest evidence-pack index for its stated preparation purpose. Not a tax opinion or filing approval.

approved_by.description: Named human who confirms the pack is ready for its stated purpose
approved_by.title: Approved By

approval_note.description: Human approval note; this is not a tax opinion
approval_note.title: Approval Note
